intro.title: THE LAST DROP
intro.text: The world was not destroyed in a day.\nIt was buried, one thrown-away thing at a time.
Cities sank under their own waste. Rivers turned the colour of old tea. Clean water became a rumour.

intro.title: THE JOURNEY
intro.text: Beyond the ruins, people whisper about a place called the Last Drop. A spring of pure water, if it exists at all.

intro.title: THE FORGOTTEN OUTPOST
intro.text: You wake here, alone and thirsty, with a cracked recorder that says: follow the old pipeline north.

intro.title: THE BATTERY FACTORY
intro.text: A battery factory where hazardous waste was left to leak. Dangerous, but it holds the first answers.

intro.title: THE GREAT DUMP
intro.text: A megacity's rubbish, piled into mountains. Everything you need is buried in it, and so is something hungry.

intro.title: THE DEAD RIVER
intro.text: Poisoned by what the heaps leaked. Clean it, and you clean the way forward.

intro.title: AND BEYOND
intro.text: Fields that forgot how to grow. Factories that never stopped. And at the end, the truth about the Last Drop.

intro.title: SURVIVE
intro.text: Sort what you find. Fight what stalks the ruins. Learn what the old world refused to.\n\nJ attack   K block   E act   Esc menu

to_factory.title: NORTH OF THE OUTPOST
to_factory.text: The pipeline runs north, straight through a fence marked with a faded battery. The recorder crackles: 'I worked here once. They said it was safe.'

to_dump.title: THE ARCHIVE
to_dump.text: The archive was damaged, but one file survived: a municipal route. Waste, shipped away to the Great Dump, year after year.

to_dump.title: INES
to_dump.text: 'Away has an address,' the voice said. 'It is always someone else's backyard.' You follow it.

to_river.title: THE DRAIN
to_river.text: The dump drains downhill through a rusted pipe. Whatever the heaps leaked is on its way to the river.

to_river.title: DOWNSTREAM
to_river.text: You smell it before you see it: metal, and something sweet. Clear water is not always safe water.

finale.title: THE FIRST DROP
finale.text: The pumps shudder and run. For the first time in years, water moves through a plant that was meant to clean it.

finale.title: THE TRUTH
finale.text: The Last Drop was never a spring. It was a place, a plan, and people willing to use what already existed.

finale.title: WHAT NOW?
finale.text: The world wasn't destroyed in a single day. And it won't be rebuilt in one either.
